steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: But's we's particular about our chompy yumms. Me's wants Potato wiv mine! Fycie and Bugs want something wiv der's as well, go and ask 'em wat dey want.

options.text: Dialogue 2

steps.speaker: Rantz
steps.text: But's we's particular about our chompy yumms. Me's wants Onion. wiv mine! Fycie and Bugs want something wiv der's as well, go and ask 'em wat dey want.

talking-to-rantz-with-a-raw-chompy-talki.player: What! Now I've got the chompy bird, you expect me to cook it as well?

talking-to-rantz-with-a-raw-chompy-talki.speaker: Rantz
talking-to-rantz-with-a-raw-chompy-talki.text: Yep, da spit's over der! Last time Rantz did yummies, got very bad, did bad things to food... and belly.

options.text: Dialogue 1

steps.speaker: Bugs
steps.text: Dad say's you's making da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's has to have equa leaves wiv mine! Chompy is our favourite yummms!

options.text: Dialogue 2

steps.speaker: Bugs
steps.text: Dad say's you's making da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's has to have cabbage wiv mine! Chompy is our favourite yummms!

options.text: Dialogue 1

steps.speaker: Fycie
steps.text: Dad say's you's roastling da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's wants tomato wiv mine! Yummy, can't wait to eats it.

options.text: Dialogue 2

steps.speaker: Fycie
steps.text: Dad say's you's roastling da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's wants doogle leaves wiv mine! Yummy, can't wait to eats it.

talking-to-rantz-with-a-raw-chompy-attem.text: You can only add ingredients when you're cooking a chompy bird. Ensure you have the seasonings you want to use in your inventory when cooking the chompy bird and you will use them automatically when cooking.
You don't have all the ingredients yet to cook the chompy bird for the ogre family.
Remember what the Ogre family wanted? Rantz wanted [potato/onion]. Fycie wanted [tomato/doogle leaves]. Bugs wanted [cabbage/equa leaves].
This is too big; you need a spit roast for this big bird.

cooking-the-chompy.text: You carefully place the chompy bird on the spit-roast.
You add the other ingredients and cook the food.
You use the [potato/onion], [tomato/doogle leaves]] and the [equa leaves/cabbage] with the chompy bird to make a seasoned chompy.

cooking-the-chompy-talking-to-bugs.speaker: Bugs
cooking-the-chompy-talking-to-bugs.text: Have you talked to Dad, he might have something for you to do.

cooking-the-chompy-talking-to-fycie.speaker: Fycie
cooking-the-chompy-talking-to-fycie.text: Go talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky chompy.

handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.speaker: Rantz
handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.text: Hey creature, did you's get da cooked chompy yet? I smelled something cooking and it mades me 'ungry. Hand over da chompy if ya know what's good for ya.

handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.player: Yes, here you go, here's your cooked chompy bird.

handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.text: You hand over the cooked chompy bird to Rantz.

handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.speaker: Rantz
handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.text: Hey hey! We got da delicious chompy bird - yay! This looks really tasty as well!

handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.speaker: Rantz
handing-the-chompy-to-rantz-or-trying-to.text: Tank's very much for da chompy... Fycie an Bugs like very much da chompy yumms! ~ The family of ogres sit down together and enjoy your well cooked chompy bird. ~
